columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Self-improving agents need independently verified recoverability before adoption
columns.title_zh: 自我改进 Agent 在采纳前需要独立验证可恢复性
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260901-011 after Skill 02 triage. EvoUndo reports that capability-improving self-modifications can still be unrecoverable and evaluates recoverability across counterfactual states rather than trusting the modifying agent's own success signal. This creates a bounded Digital Employee governance question: what independent adoption gate must prove rollback semantics before a self-improvement is allowed to become active?
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260901-011。EvoUndo 表明，提高能力的自我修改仍可能不可恢复，并通过 Counterfactual State 独立检验可恢复性，而不是相信修改 Agent 自己的成功信号。它形成一个边界清晰的数字员工治理问题：自我改进在允许生效之前，必须经过怎样的独立采纳门禁来证明回滚语义？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify EvoUndo's task construction, state-addressing and witness semantics, recovery language, counterfactual evaluation procedure, capability-versus-recoverability measurements, independent-verifier role, failure cases, and limits on generalizing the result to production self-modifying workers.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 EvoUndo 的任务构造、State Addressing 与 Witness 语义、Recovery Language、Counterfactual 评估过程、能力与可恢复性测量、独立验证器角色、失败案例，以及将结论推广到生产型自修改 Worker 时的边界。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.reason: No Selection. The strongest Industry Architecture candidates expose useful mechanisms—DPoP sender-constrained connector tokens, WebMCP confirmation boundaries, runtime policy/credential control planes, and A2A's negotiation-to-task commitment boundary—but today's Signal Pool provides only one primary implementation or vendor source for each. Skill 02's evidence-sufficiency gate requires stronger independent, comparative, benchmark or failure evidence before elevating one into a Daily Research Object.
columns.reason_zh: No Selection。行业架构栏目最强候选包括 DPoP Sender-constrained 连接器令牌、WebMCP 确认边界、Runtime Policy/Credential Control Plane，以及 A2A 从 Negotiation 到 Durable Task 的承诺边界；但今天的 Signal Pool 对每个问题都只有一个主要实现或厂商来源。按 Skill 02 的 Evidence Sufficiency Gate，在缺少独立比较、基准或失败证据时，不应强行提升为 Daily Research Object。
columns.next: Retain SIG-20260901-001, 003, 008 and 009 as candidates for later comparison. Reading must perform no Industry Architecture Deep Reading for this run because Queue made an explicit No Selection decision.
columns.next_zh: 保留 SIG-20260901-001、003、008、009 为 Candidate，等待后续比较证据。本轮 Queue 已明确作出 No Selection，因此 Reading 不得为行业架构栏目执行 Deep Reading。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Agent plugin isolation needs a durable recovery transcript outside the failed process
columns.title_zh: Agent Plugin 隔离需要位于故障进程之外的持久恢复 Transcript
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260901-010 after Skill 02 triage. Logos combines peer-process plugin isolation with an append-only transcript used to resume killed sessions without repeating effects. That provides a concrete engineering question spanning two failure boundaries: how much execution state must live outside the failed worker, and what effect identity is required so recovery can reconstruct state without duplicating already-committed external actions?
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260901-010。Logos 将 Plugin 隔离到 Peer Process，并使用 Append-only Transcript 恢复被终止的 Session，同时避免重复副作用。它形成一个跨越两类故障边界的具体工程问题：多少执行状态必须位于故障 Worker 之外，以及恢复时需要怎样的 Effect Identity，才能重建状态而不重复已经提交的外部动作？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the process-isolation topology, transcript schema and persistence boundary, crash/restart protocol, effect-deduplication semantics, failure experiments, recovery guarantees, unsupported side effects, and whether the evidence establishes bounded recovery rather than universal exactly-once execution.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验进程隔离拓扑、Transcript Schema 与持久边界、Crash/Restart 协议、Effect 去重语义、故障实验、恢复保证、不受支持的副作用，以及证据证明的是有界恢复还是更强的通用 Exactly-once Execution。
